description:
Welcome to Shanghai Tower !

The 2nd tallest building in the world (after the Burj Khalifa in Dubaï) and the highest public observatory in the world

2nd highest : 632m (Burj Khalifa = 828m)
2nd highest Top Floor : 587m (Burj Khalifa = 605m)
1st Highest Observatory : 562m ( Burj Khalifa = 555m)

----------

We are two French expatriates in Shanghai and we are at the origin of this Walk in Shanghai channel. Due to the health context, friends and family cannot come to visit China and visit the city we live in. It is from this observation that the idea of a Youtube channel came to us. The goal is to present the city without filters, raw and in real time for total immersion.

We offer walking tours through the city, tourist areas and more typical neighborhoods. From Jing'An temple to the Bund, passing through the French concession, old town and pudong business district, we take you to a city that never sleeps!

----------

SETUP

📱 Camera: iPhone 11 Pro
🕹️ Gimbal: DJI OM 4SE https://www.dji.com/om-4-se
🔋 Power bank: Mi Power Bank 2 10.000 mAh https://buy.mi.com/fr/item/3182000033
🥾 Shoes: Depends on the weather

----------
